description: This file is a PHP class extending a Controller, handling the 'Online' dashboard functionality in the OpenCart administration panel. It includes methods for displaying online customer data, saving settings, and providing online status information via AJAX. The class interacts with models, views, and configuration settings specific to the online dashboard extension.

classes.name: Online
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Online' dashboard extension in the admin area, providing methods to display online customers, save settings, and retrieve online status data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the online dashboard page, setting up data and breadcrumbs, and rendering the online form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration settings for the online dashboard extension via AJAX, returning a JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Retrieves and displays information about currently online customers, including total count and online details view.
